name: Innocent Trap
source:
The main character is captured by the futanari. He will have to carry out all her dirty orders to get out of captivity.

[From [url=https://spodvohom-games.itch.io/innocent-trap]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
男主角落入了扶她女子手中沦为阶下囚。为了重获自由，他不得不乖乖听命，照办她下达的一切下流指令。

[摘自[url=https://spodvohom-games.itch.io/innocent-trap]itch.io[/url]]
